final: SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, (AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds)) / (SELECT AVG(t2.Bytes * 1.0 / t2.Milliseconds) FROM Track AS t2 JOIN MediaType AS m2 ON m2.MediaTypeId = t2.MediaTypeId) AS relative_to_overall_avg FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name
